description: Pay x402 APIs in USDC on Base, Solana, and BNB Chain with spend mandates, receipts, idempotency.
name: io.github.stevemilton/x402-payagent-mcp

environmentVariables.description: ArisPay developer API key (ap_live_… / ap_test_…). Optional — the setup tool can self-provision one from just an email, or set PAYAGENT_PRIVATE_KEY to sign locally with no account.
environmentVariables.name: ARISPAY_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: EVM private key for permissionless local signing (zero-signup mode): pay signs x402 payments with it directly — no ArisPay account needed. Generate one with `npx payagent wallet new`. Never sent to any server.
environmentVariables.name: PAYAGENT_PRIVATE_KEY
